properties.descriptionHtml: Microsoft Sentinel data connector for Defender XDR portal-internal /apiproxy/ telemetry (Action Center · CloudApps · Exposure Management · Identity · Threat Analytics · etc.). Operator-curated · no Microsoft SLA on the /apiproxy/ surface. v0.1.0 ships connector-only · analytic rules + workbooks in v0.2.0.

resources.comments: ITER6 M4 Path A · Sentinel Connector Card · Microsoft.OperationalInsights workspaces/providers/dataConnectorDefinitions (V3 · kind=Customizable). value: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where Portal == 'Defender' and TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | take 1
union withsource=TableName isfuzzy=true Defender_*_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and SuccessKind == 'live' | summarize hits=count() | where hits > 0
XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where Status == 'AuthFatal' and TimeGenerated > ago(4h) | summarize fatals=count() | where fatals == 0

union withsource=TableName isfuzzy=true Defender_*_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize WithPD=countif(isnotempty(ProjectedData)), Total=count() | extend Pct=iff(Total>0, round(100.0*WithPD/Total,1), 0.0) | where Pct >= 20.0

customs.name: Microsoft Defender XDR service account
customs.description: Dedicated SA in your Entra tenant with **Security Reader** + **Microsoft Defender Analyst**, Conditional-Access-exempt for unattended TOTP/Passkey sign-in.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Service account
instructionSteps.description: Create a dedicated Entra user. Grant **Security Reader + Microsoft Defender Analyst**. Set MFA to TOTP (or Passkey ECDSA-P256) and capture the seed. **Conditional Access exemption from interactive-MFA / device-compliance is required**.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy
instructionSteps.description: Use the **Deploy to Azure** button OR `az deployment group create`. Provide the workspace ARM ID, SA UPN, password, and TOTP seed (or Passkey PEM).

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify
instructionSteps.description: Within ~20 min the heartbeat lands in `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` and the card flips **Connected**. Tables surface in both legacy Azure portal Sentinel UI and the unified Microsoft Defender XDR portal.
